title: Pentagon probes possible cyberattack after freezer failures spoil food at US bases
summary_full: The Pentagon said a unit of US Cyber Command, the military's cyber force, was "working in close coordination with interagency and law enforcement partners". It did not provide further details. The US Army Criminal Investigation Division confirmed that its Cyber Field Office was involved and was working with French law enforcement to better understand "the refrigeration outages in Europe".
